layout: 2x2 transparent sprite sheets: base, open, mid, blink

prompts.prompt:
Create a production sprite sheet for an animated SEO advisory web app. Subject: a stylized 3D caricature of Aleyda Solis, inspired by a public SEO practitioner, not a photograph. Image 1 is a STYLE reference only: match the polished soft 3D cartoon bust, slightly oversized head, friendly expressive eyes, front lighting and materials, not its identity. Recognizable Aleyda Solis: woman with long dark brown hair parted slightly to the side, warm light-to-medium skin, brown eyes and friendly professional expression, charcoal blazer and simple dark blouse.
CRITICAL GRID: one square image, an exact 2 by 2 uniform grid with four equal square tiles, no gutters, no labels. Tile top-left: eyes open, mouth fully closed, slight friendly smile (base). Tile top-right: eyes open, mouth noticeably open as if speaking (open). Tile bottom-left: eyes open, mouth slightly open intermediate speaking shape (mid). Tile bottom-right: eyes fully closed in a natural blink, mouth closed (blink).
The SAME IDENTICAL character, outfit, front-facing head/shoulders bust, pose, scale, crop and position in all four tiles. Only mouth or eyelids change. No hand gestures. Head centered horizontally in each tile, crown about 7% from tile top, head and shoulders fully fit tile width, shoulders extend to bottom edge. Maintain exact face alignment across states for CSS animation. Transparent background around each bust, genuine alpha, no scenery or backdrop, no dark matte, no cast shadow, no frames, no text, no logos. Only four figures. Clean edges. Do not draw a checkerboard.
